title_ar: Hamdan officially opens 19th edition of Dubai World Cup
brief: Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum announced the official opening of the 19th edition of the Dubai World Cup Carnival (DWCC) at the Meydan racecourse in Nad Al Shiba, Dubai.
text: In presence of UAE Vice President, Prime Minister and Ruler of Dubai His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum announced the official opening of the 19th edition of the Dubai World Cup Carnival (DWCC) at the Meydan racecourse in Nad Al Shiba, Dubai. More than 80,000 spectators and horse race enthusiasts followed the opening ceremony as it kicked off with the rendition of the UAE national anthem by the Dubai Police music band. Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed wished all participants good luck. Cash prizes for the first eight rounds of the 2014 Dubai World Cup Carnival (DWCC) exceeded US$17 million leading to the 9th and final round, the Dubai World Cup; the richest horse race in the world. Godolphin’s African Story flexed muscle and galloped to victory to claim the 2000-metre 2014 Dubai World Cup title. UAE Vice President, Prime Minister and Ruler of Dubai His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum received the 2014 Dubai World Cup trophy from his brother the Dubai Deputy Ruler and Minister of Finance Sheikh Hamdan bin Rashid Al Maktoum. Flanked by Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum and Dubai Deputy Ruler Sheikh Maktoum bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Sheikh Mohammed raised the trophy amid loud cheers and applause.
